title: Which wires should compare?
hook: A special input shape makes a fixed comparator pattern possible.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Use distant comparator pairs to merge a bitonic sequence and preserve the bitonic halves.

misconception: A comparison network must adapt its wires to observed data.
objective: Use distant comparator pairs to merge a bitonic sequence and preserve the bitonic halves.

claims.text: Distant compare-exchanges separate the smaller and larger halves. Each half remains bitonic, so the same fixed pattern can recurse; the special input shape is what makes this merge network valid.
